added.summary: overflow-wrap: anywhere and break-word (and word-break: break-word) break a word too wide for its line between its letters once it has a line of its own; anywhere also lowers the text's min-content width to its widest letter.

text-align-last aligns a text's last line and each line a forced break ends (justify-all justifies it too); text-justify takes a justified line's room at its spaces (auto, inter-word), between every two characters (inter-character) or nowhere (none).
